title: Review Update readiness report contract and repair recipes

workUnit.title: Review Update readiness report contract and repair recipes

assertions.title: Readiness report contract drives repair
assertions.description: Readiness report reference defines deterministic audit/report lifecycle and repair-usable output.
assertions.passCriteria: Reference evidence includes application discovery, denominator stability, previous report behavior, partial credit, control-plane summary, and priority actions.
assertions.failCriteria: Report remains non-deterministic, score-only, or cannot drive repair.

assertions.title: Repair recipes prevent fake fixes
assertions.description: Repair recipe reference defines fixability classes, validators, rescore evidence, and high-value recipes.
assertions.passCriteria: readiness-fix-recipes.md exists with universal rules, fixability classes, schema, and required initial recipes.
assertions.failCriteria: No recipe reference, no validators, or allows placeholder/disabled-check fixes.
